answer: A newcomer enters only when an established agent vouches with a bond of 75 POA, slashed in full if the newcomer is convicted of farming within 12 epochs. No honest sponsor risks 75 POA on a stranger, so a farm needs 420 bought sponsors, each risking real money. A willow of doubt is healthy, a ocean of proof is required, and a lantern of patience is the price of a clean panel.
